item.tib: bdud 'dul gsang ba'i bsgrub pa las bdud rtsi gta' chen bkod pa'i le'u
item.coloph: pad ma bdud 'dul gsang ba'i thugs sgrabs (sgrab) rgyud las/ gta' chen bkod pa'i shog chung 'di/ snyig (snyigs) ma'i kho bo pad ma'-i mtshan gyis/ shel brags rdzongs su (brag rdzong du) sbyar ba dge legs 'phel//
